title: C TDMA: reset SFN on RPL version change (spec 02a 2a.5 R-02a-045/022)
description: Smallest child of b7z9.24. tdma.c:111-114 lichen_ccp_fsm_event reaches DRIFTING on LICHEN_CCP_EVENT_RPL_VERSION but never resets SFN; spec 2a.5 R-02a-045/022: an RPL version change MUST reset the SFN relative to the new root. Fix: in the RPL_VERSION arm reset tdma->superframe (and derived slot) to the new root's SFN-0 baseline consistent with lichen_tdma_init's placeholder semantics. Extend the tdma host test (tdma_guard_budget or routing_dispatch) to pin: version-change event -> superframe reset + state transition. Discovered from project-LICHEN-worker6-b7z9.24.
close_reason: SFN reset on RPL version change landed (commit 74cc8914b4): (1) lichen_tdma_ctx gains uint8_t eui64[8] copied at lichen_tdma_init (the CCP FSM has no ctx access, so the node EUI64 is stored for slot recomputation); (2) the CCP FSM RPL_VERSION arm (SYNCED state) additionally resets tdma->superframe = 0 and recomputes tdma->slot = lichen_tdma_compute_slot(tdma->eui64, 0, n_slots) — the SFN-0 placeholder baseline; real hash(EUI64)+SFN slot is installed by the next valid beacon; (3) test pinned in tdma_guard_budget: init -> INIT -> VALID_BEACON -> SYNCED, superframe=77/slot=6 forced, RPL_VERSION -> DRIFTING + synced=false + superframe=0 + slot==compute_slot(eui64,0,n_slots). Review-note resolution: the RPL_VERSION reset test EXISTS in the diff and passes (reviewers ran before the file settled or missed it); the imprecise 'consistent with init' comment was refined (the slot is the retained SFN-0 baseline from the stored EUI64). Verification: host build+run all asserts green; ZEPHYR native_sim routing_dispatch build green. Codereview 3x delegated to kimi-k3: pass 2 verdict deterministic-reset/degraded-to-contention/EUI64-no-hazard all clear; pass 3 comment-precision fix applied. Sibling b7z9.24.2 (root-selection ordered criteria module, port of python select_root) remains for the full 2a.5 feature.
